<!--
Thanks for contributing to Pitchfork UI!
Please use a Conventional Commit style PR title (feat:, fix:, docs:, chore:, etc.)
so release-please can version correctly.
-->

## Summary

<!-- What does this PR change and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new component, prop, or capability
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation / Storybook only
- [ ] `chore` / `refactor` / `test` — no user-facing change

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run test` passes
- [ ] For a new/changed component: stories, MDX docs, and at least one a11y-focused test are included
- [ ] CSS uses the token → theme alias → component variable chain (no hard-coded colors/spacing/radii)
- [ ] Verified in both light and dark mode
- [ ] Checked responsive behaviour (320px → desktop) where relevant

## Screenshots / recordings

<!-- For visual changes, include before/after if possible. -->
